subject: [hw] R1 finding F19 (V32, LOW, test-only): rev 4 TSan e2e fails at t_v32_guest.c:719/825 (timedlock returns 22, not ETIMEDOUT/0)
body:
I re-ran shim/test_v32/run_tests.sh on rev 4. ASan and -O2 are green (V32DIRECTRESULT 2390/2390, V32RESULT 10759/10759), but the TSan build fails:
  N2TEST V32 FAIL e2e_tsan
  guest check failed at t_v32_guest.c:719
  guest check failed at t_v32_guest.c:825
  guest g_dbg: 8 1 1 22 22 22 0 0
  V32RESULT 10728/10730
Line 719 is `ck(rc == ETIMEDOUT || (g_relax_timeouts && rc == 0))` for pthread_mutex_timedlock, line 825 is the rwlock timedwrlock `ck(rc == ETIMEDOUT || rc == EDEADLK)`. g_dbg[4]/[5] are 22 (EINVAL), which neither branch accepts. The comment at 717 says TSan ignores the timeout, but the observed return is EINVAL, and g_relax_timeouts appears not to cover this path in the TSan e2e driver. This looks like a test/driver expectation problem, not a shim defect (the ASan/-O2 runs and the direct timedlock tests pass).

Please either relax the two checks for the TSan environment (accept EINVAL when the driver sets g_relax_timeouts, or make the driver set it for the e2e TSan run), or document the TSan limitation and skip those two cases under TSan. run_tests.sh must end with N2TEST V32 PASS for the package to be green. I am keeping V32 at accept-with-findings (F19 test-only) until then; the implementation review found no shim defect.
